title.narrative: AgriGreen Initiative - Green Economic Growth through Sustainable Agricultural Practices

description.narrative: The Overall Objective (OO) is to support the transition to green economic growth where sustainable and gender-responsive consumption and production practices and food security are ensured. The Specific Objective(s) (SOs) is to catalyse a shift to more sustainable and environmentally responsible agricultural practices, in selected value chains and with special attention to youth and women. The Outputs to be delivered by this action include: Output 1: Strengthened policy, institutional, and digital frameworks for sustainable production in selected value chains (indicatively rubber): support to EU GlobalGateway strategic orientation, formulation of relevant elements of agricultural policy such as alignment with market needs, value addition, improved integration with export markets in particular EU, role of standards for production and exports, digitalisation, farmer organisational and institutional set up, value chain inefficiencies, other. The focus will be on selected value chains, indicatively rubber.Output 2: Enhanced capacities of small-scale producers to apply sustainable agricultural production and marketing practices in selected value chains (indicatively rubber): supporting service delivery to small holder women and men farmers to adopt sustainable, agro-ecological and eco-friendly practices. The capacity of producers to address market needs and comply with EU standards (e.g. EU DR) will be strengthened. Additionally, post-harvest losses will be reduced with improved capacity for processing and value addition. The focus will be on selected value chains, indicatively rubber.Output 3: Improved capacity of women for practicing sustainable agriculture production, value addition, processing and marketing: improve services to empower women-headed households practising agriculture with the knowledge, skill and resources necessary to establish and maintain home production in particular home-gardens, ensuring year-round access to nutritious, locally grown produce, while simultaneously promoting women¿s economic independence through entrepreneurial capacity building and market linkages.
